author: KEXP
description: Bangkok-based band Makara give listeners a taste of folk flavors, modern grooves, and 60s Thai psychedelia in our latest Live on KEXP session. In-studio with host Diana Ratsamee, the band share a performance of "Yong Song" and more.
title: Makara performs "Yong Song" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
